faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: What is KYC and why is it required?
faq.a1: KYC (Know Your Customer) is a mandatory identity verification process required under Israeli law and AML regulations.
faq.a2: Usually 1-3 business days. You will receive updates via email and your personal area.
faq.a3: Bit, PayBox and direct crypto transfer. Each method is subject to eligibility checks.
faq.a4: Orders in 'Draft' status can be cancelled before approval. After approval, contact support.
faq.q5: What happens if my order is rejected?
faq.a5: You will receive a notification with the reason. You can contact support for clarification.
faq.a6: Yes. All KYC documents are encrypted and stored on secure servers in Israel. We will not sell or share your data with third parties.
